task_reconstruction.official_task: Cut waiting time and its variance at airport security while keeping security standards.

section_map.summary: Closed form for expected wait, with the negativity flagged.
Simulation matches theory from 50 to 4050 passengers.

contributions.summary: A scan-time density built as the maximum of two independent scans.
A profit rate that prices officers against throughput.

dependency_graph.handoff: the scan-time density used as a service distribution
the total time that enters the profit rate

assumptions.summary: Transit time is negligible and officers are identical.
Someone is always waiting, so the max with zero is dropped.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Exponential rates by maximum likelihood, service by kernel density.
Officer wage from one airport, security fee from the published charge.

models.summary: Precheck scan time as a maximum of two scans.

verification.summary: Closed form plotted against simulation from 50 to 4050 passengers.
Predicted transition points overlaid on the simulated curves.

results_trace.summary: Wait collapses when arrival rate equals service rate over station count.
Precheck optimum: 3 and 3 stations, 0.140 dollars per second.
Regular optimum: 2 and 3 stations, 0.083 dollars per second.
Precheck gives a 68.6 percent revenue gain per passenger.

writing_logic.summary: Each assumption is followed by a remark.
The negative wait is named, traced, and deferred to the simulation.
The winning configuration is reported with its objective value.

language_observations.summary: The paper is previewed as four parts.
An inconsistency is confessed in the section that creates it.
A failed idea is reported as a failure.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 5 overlays simulated and theoretical averages.
Figure 9 is a profit heat map over station counts.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Two optima with dollar values make the staffing claim checkable.

independent_extensions.summary: Restore the max with zero in the closed form and compare with equation (2).

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Scan time is the slower of two independent scans.
Two parallel FIFO networks, one per lane.
Rates by maximum likelihood, wage from one airport.
Closed form checked from 50 to 4050 passengers.
Station counts chosen by a profit heat map.
Revenue gain of precheck stated as a percentage.
Station counts varied against arrival rate.
Each assumption paired with a remark.
Negative expected wait flagged and kept.

unresolved_questions: Equation (2) can be negative because the max with zero was dropped. The paper flags it and removes it only in the simulation. Both kept.
The kernel bandwidth is not reported. The densities are kept as plotted.
The officer wage comes from one airport. Kept as printed.
